analysis.title: China's mega squeeze: dead cat bounce or something bigger
key_insights: Chinese equities rebounded sharply after a steep selloff. ChiNext bounced 5% and STAR 50 surged 10% overnight.
JPMorgan notes the CSI 300 had fallen 22% from its June peak, and the CSI 500 and CSI 1000 had fallen 31%. Crowding and momentum indicators were near depressed levels.
ChiNext still trades well below its 200-day moving average, so the technical damage remains substantial.

JPMorgan cites two regulatory meetings on November 2 aimed at stabilizing equities, including expanding capital-market support tools and improving stock buyback financing. There are signs of government-backed buying returning.
JPMorgan sees an emerging policy floor but says sustained inflows are needed to confirm a durable bottom.
A-share ETF inflows were RMB 379bn in October, including RMB 156bn into CSI 300 trackers, RMB 58bn into ChiNext and RMB 54bn into STAR ETFs. Q3 inflows were RMB 471bn.
JPMorgan's screen finds several Chinese AI infrastructure stocks with 14-day RSI below 20, including AMEC at 14.3. Semiconductor and tech hardware shares fell about 26% over four weeks.

Memory, server/switch manufacturers and semiconductor equipment stocks have moved back toward more reasonable historical valuations. JPMorgan argues the domestic AI supply chain benefits from government-backed investment priorities.

Q3 earnings in China's information technology sector rose 55% y/y and healthcare profits rose 49%, while the CSI 300 earnings fell 4%. The market sold some of the sectors with the strongest earnings growth.

sector_views.sector: China AI supply chain (memory, servers/switches, semiconductor equipment)
sector_views.rationale: Valuations have reset toward historical norms and government-backed investment priorities give greater demand visibility, per JPMorgan.

earnings_insights: China information technology sector Q3 earnings +55% y/y, healthcare +49% y/y, versus a 4% decline for the CSI 300 (reported Q3 figures per JPMorgan).
risk_factors: Sustained ETF and policy inflows are needed to confirm a durable bottom.
ChiNext remains well below its 200-day moving average, so the rebound could be a dead-cat bounce.
vol_and_positioning: JPMorgan says crowding and momentum indicators were approaching depressed levels before the rebound, setting up a potential violent reversal.
14-day RSI below 20 for several Chinese AI infrastructure stocks, with AMEC at 14.3.
ChiNext remains well below its 200-day moving average despite the bounce.
geopolitical: Beijing held two regulatory meetings on November 2 to stabilize Chinese equities, with government-backed buying reportedly returning.

tension_points.bull_case: Oversold conditions, a policy floor, RMB 379bn of October ETF inflows and strong tech earnings (IT Q3 earnings +55% y/y) support a larger rebound.

tension_points.what_invalidates: A failure of ETF and government-backed inflows to persist, which JPMorgan says is needed to confirm a durable bottom.
